description: Compare two company references using supplied company-number/LEI equality and normalised name similarity. When one reference has a UK company number and the other only a name, optionally corroborates against Companies House. LEIs are compared as supplied, not validated against GLEIF by this tool. Returns an identifier-comparison verdict, review reasons and signal provenance. Names alone remain uncertain. Conflicting identifiers require review; confidence is null because no calibrated identity probability is available.
name: entity_match
title: Entity match verdict
